Mortal Blow Lv. 1 Attacks the target's vital points with 73 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Double Shot Lv. 1 Supplements P. Atk. with 1476 Power to fire 2 arrows in rapid succession. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Burst Shot Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage around enemy. Power: 1050 in PvP, 1365 in PvE. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Unlock Lv. 1 Opens Lv. 1 doors with a 30% chance. Also opens treasure chests with a 100% chance.
Sting Lv. 1 Attacks an enemy with 82 Power added to P. Atk., and inflicts Bleed causing loss of 25 HP per second, inflicts minor damage based on walked distance. Over-hit is possible.
Fatal Counter Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. by 3926 Power to fire an agony-inducing arrow at a target. The power of the attack increases as Your's HP decreases. Over-hit is possible.
Lethal Shot Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 5798. Burns 10% of current enemy's CP 3 times over 10 sec. Ignores Shield Defence. Half-kill, Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Multiple Shot Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage on multiple enemies. Power: 4270. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Death Shot Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 11440. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Confusion Lv. 1 Throws an enemy into confusion, changing their target of attack.
Drain Health Lv. 1 Inflicts dark damage on the target with 20 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 20% of the damage inflicted on target as HP.
Self-Treatment Lv. 1 Restores 25 HP every second.
